hints.tr: Otomatik sayfa sonunu kapat: `pdf.set_auto_page_break(False)`; yoksa resim ikinci sayfaya taşabilir.
hints.en: Turn automatic page breaks off: `pdf.set_auto_page_break(False)`; otherwise the image may spill onto a second page.

hints.tr: Ortalamak için resmin x'i `(pdf.w - genişlik) / 2`; yazı için genişliği `pdf.w` olan bir hücre ve `align="C"`. Beyaz: `pdf.set_text_color(255, 255, 255)`.
hints.en: To center, the image's x is `(pdf.w - width) / 2`; for the text, a cell as wide as `pdf.w` with `align="C"`. White: `pdf.set_text_color(255, 255, 255)`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
from fpdf import FPDF


def main():
    name = input("Name: ")
    make_shirtificate(name)


def make_shirtificate(name):
    pdf = FPDF(orientation="P", format="A4")
    pdf.set_auto_page_break(False)
    pdf.add_page()
    pdf.set_font("helvetica", "B", 42)
    pdf.cell(0, 50, "CS50 Shirtificate", align="C")
    width = 180
    pdf.image("shirtificate.png", x=(pdf.w - width) / 2, y=70, w=width)
    pdf.set_font_size(24)
    pdf.set_text_color(255, 255, 255)
    pdf.set_xy(0, 120)
    pdf.cell(pdf.w, 10, f"{name} took CS50", align="C")
    pdf.output("shirtificate.pdf")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

def make_shirtificate(name):
    pdf = FPDF(orientation="P", format="A4")
    pdf.set_auto_page_break(False)
    pdf.add_page()
    pdf.set_font("helvetica", "B", 42)
    pdf.cell(0, 50, "CS50 Shirtificate", align="C")
    width = 180
    pdf.image("shirtificate.png", x=(pdf.w - width) / 2, y=70, w=width)
    pdf.set_font_size(24)
    pdf.set_text_color(255, 255, 255)
    pdf.set_xy(0, 120)
    pdf.cell(pdf.w, 10, f"{name} took CS50", align="C")
